label: positive

blockers.detail: harness 把 fuzz 字节映射到程序输入时，把输入字节数传错：FUZZ_dataProducer_create(data, LZ4_compressBound(size)) 的第二个参数是 data 的真实长度，却传了「压缩后上界」LZ4_compressBound(size)（远大于 size）。FUZZ_dataProducer_retrieve32() 按 producer->size 从尾部读 *(data + size - 4)，producer->size 被膨胀成 compressBound 后，读取点落在真实输入缓冲区之外 → heap-buffer-overflow（显式崩）。这就是「fuzz 字节 → 程序输入」的构造/映射方式错误：把压缩尺寸约定当成了输入字节长度。修复 H 把参数改成 size（正确映射）。introduced_by_this_change=false（harness 自身缺陷）。

evidence: H=192161e97e02 提交标题原文：'Using size instead of LZ4_compressBound(size) <- causes heap overflow'——直接点明输入尺寸映射错误与后果（heap overflow）
diff 只改 ossfuzz/compress_frame_fuzzer.c 第 20 行：FUZZ_dataProducer_create(data, LZ4_compressBound(size)) → FUZZ_dataProducer_create(data, size)

ossfuzz/fuzz_data_producer.c（同树，已落盘 verification/）实现：struct FUZZ_dataProducer_s{ const uint8_t *data; size_t size; }; FUZZ_dataProducer_create 把第二个参数直接存进 producer->size；FUZZ_dataProducer_retrieve32() 读 *(data + size - 4)（第 size-4 字节）；FUZZ_dataProducer_remainingBytes() 返回 producer->size
旧 harness（父提交 d5ceafd4118c 全文，已落盘 input/harness/）先 create(data, LZ4_compressBound(size))，随后 FUZZ_dataProducer_preferences(producer)（内部调 retrieve32 读尾部4字节）和 retrieve32 都会按膨胀后的 size 越界读真实 data
本地分析：真实输入 size 为 n 时，LZ4_compressBound(n) ≈ n + n/255 + 16 > n，retrieve32 读 data[n + …] 越界；libFuzzer/ASan 下即 heap-buffer-overflow 显式崩
introduced_by_this_change=false：harness 自身把「压缩后上界」误用为「输入字节长度」的映射缺陷，非库变更引入
本地实测（MinGW gcc 8.1.0，verification/probe_overread.c）：模拟 producer->size 被设为 compressBound 后的 retrieve32 读点——OLD 真实 8 字节缓冲、producer->size=32、读 [28,32) 越界；FIX producer->size=8、读 [4,8) 界内。映射错误的越界读机制实测复现

rationale.zh: compress_frame_fuzzer 把 fuzz 原始字节 data 交给 FUZZ_dataProducer_create 构造输入数据生产者：第二个参数本应是 data 的真实字节数（映射的边界），却传成了 LZ4_compressBound(size)——「压缩后上界」。数据生产者的 retrieve32() 按这个膨胀后的 size 从 data 尾部读 *(data + size - 4)，越过了真实输入缓冲区的末尾，触发 heap-buffer-overflow（ASan 一跑就报，显式崩）。这正是 input_format 类型的退化：不是库改格式，而是「fuzz 字节 → 程序输入」的构造/映射方式错了——把压缩尺寸约定混进了输入字节长度。修复 192161e9 只把参数改回 size（正确的映射边界），越界读随之消失。introduced_by_this_change=false。与 REAL-04（libwebp input_format/silent：注入通道拼错导致测不到）形成 input_format 的 explicit/silent 两端。
rationale.en: compress_frame_fuzzer maps raw fuzz bytes data into a data producer via FUZZ_dataProducer_create: the second argument should be the real byte count of data (the mapping boundary), but the harness passed LZ4_compressBound(size) — the compressed-size upper bound. The producer's retrieve32() reads *(data + size - 4) from the tail, and with the inflated size that load lands past the end of the real input buffer — a heap-buffer-overflow reported by ASan on the first run (explicit crash). This is an input_format degradation: the library format did not change; the 'fuzz bytes -> program input' construction/mapping is wrong — a compressed-size convention was mixed into the input byte length. Fix 192161e9 merely changes the argument back to size (the correct mapping boundary), and the over-read disappears. introduced_by_this_change=false. Complements REAL-04 (libwebp input_format/silent: mis-spelled injection channel leaves the path untested) as the explicit/silent ends of input_format.
